summary_1line: After a brutal royal hunt, Dushmanta enters a serene forest hermitage by the Malini river, filled with ascetics, animals, and divine beauty.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dushmanta strides through the forest with bow and sword as fleeing animals scatter and wounded elephants crash through the trees.
As Dushmanta enters the tranquil grove, flowering trees bend in the breeze and shower blossoms over the king beneath a canopy of birds and bees.
On the banks of the clear Malini river, ascetics sit beside sacred fires while deer wander peacefully among flower-strewn ground beneath tall trees.
